knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The worker leaves and reports. Looking closer or moving containers is not permitted.
The sighting record holds what, where, when and who was told. Personal details are not part of it.

practicalCriteria: In a paper scenario, the learner lists the actions in order for a suspected laboratory sighting. Pass: stop, leave, notify and record all appear in order.
The learner completes a sighting record for a fictional scene without naming or handling any material. Pass: what, where, when and who notified are all recorded.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: Signs of a suspected laboratory are seen.
Any item would need to be touched to continue.
